justiceSays.line: Greta leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something. Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Journal: Counter: Buy it off — It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase.
Word reaches you, days late: Isabella stands accused over what happened to Jose. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Vera has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Isabella answers for what happened to Jose.
Vera calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.
The fire is built high. Nobody speaks while the count is taken — you can hear the wind past the edge of the light.
Vera counts on their fingers, twice, like they don't trust the first number. Then, to the fire: "0 for guilty. 7 against."
A long exhale moves around the fire like weather. "Not guilty — this time."
★ IDENTIFIED: Pokeweed. Smooth stalks, purple-red stems, dark berry clusters. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

Isabella spends the afternoon with the vine with elaborate purple-and-white flowers and egg-sized green fruit that wrinkles yellow when ripe — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. Edible, but it argues on the way down. The fire's verdict: food, carefully. Small amounts.
★ IDENTIFIED: Wild Ramps. Broad smooth leaves, onion smell. Spring only. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📺 SYSTEM: ""You CAUGHT the lie AND you can PROVE it?! That's not justice, that's a CHECKMATE! The guilty are lawyering up! PRESENT THE EVIDENCE!""
